description: This Java source file defines a REST controller named FaqController that exposes an endpoint for retrieving frequently asked questions (FAQs) for the Kavia AI platform. It sets up an HTTP GET endpoint at /api/faqs which returns a list of FAQ entries by invoking methods from the FaqService.

classes.name: FaqController
classes.description: Controller exposing an endpoint to retrieve FAQs about Kavia AI.

methods.name: getFaqs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /api/faqs, returns a list of FAQ entries.
